h1: AI UGC Ads Made for YouTube Shorts
lead: Plenty of YouTube ads lose the viewer before the product appears. A YouTube Shorts ad can sound like a creator, open fast, and keep people watching long enough to buy.
card: YouTube Shorts ads from a photo or a product link, in the tall shape Shorts uses.

faq.q: Does a Short start from a product link?
faq.a: Yes. Paste a product link or upload a photo to start a Short. You can make a separate wide video for other YouTube placements.

faq.q: What does a YouTube Shorts ad cost?
faq.a: You pay 24, 40, 60, or 120 credits for a 6, 10, 15, or 30 second Short. Starter costs $24.50 monthly for 200 credits, Pro $35 for 300, and Premium $63 for 600.

faq.q: Which frame should a Shorts ad use?
faq.a: Use vertical 9:16 for Shorts. Choose 16:9 for a separate wide placement and check the finished video before posting.

faq.q: Are AI-generated videos allowed in YouTube ads?
faq.a: Yes. AI videos can run as YouTube ads when they meet YouTube’s current policies. Keep claims truthful, avoid impersonation, and disclose AI use when required.

faq.q: Can AI YouTube Shorts ads improve watch time?
faq.a: It can hold attention when the product appears early and the message fits the viewer. Test different openings; results depend on your audience.

faq.q: Can I change the script, the avatar, and the picture?
faq.a: Yes. Change the message, actor, voice, or visuals and make another Short. You can test more versions without filming again.

faq.q: What is AI UGC for YouTube Shorts?
faq.a: An AI YouTube Shorts ad is a vertical product video made with an AI actor and voice. You can make one without filming or hiring a creator.

faq.q: How realistic are AI actors and voices?
faq.a: AI actors can look and sound realistic, with lips matching the words. Review each video and disclose AI use when YouTube requires it.
